name: structFindKey
description:
Searches recursively through a substructure of nested arrays,
structures, and other elements, for structures whose values
match the search key in the value parameter.
syntax: structFindKey( struct Top, string Key, [string Scope] )

params.name: Top
params.description: object from which to start search. This parameter requires an object, not a name of an object.

params.name: Scope
params.description:
- one (default): returns one matching key.
- all: returns all matching keys
